## Checklist (docs/engineering/ENGINEERING_GUIDE.md §14)

- [ ] Does this change require a `docs/` update (schema, API, architecture, AI pipeline, structure)? If so, it's included in this PR.
- [ ] Does this change touch an organization-scoped table/module? If so, a tenant-isolation test was added.
- [ ] Does this change add or modify an API endpoint? If so, the Swagger/OpenAPI output is complete (summary, tags, example responses).
- [ ] Does this change add a new dependency? If so, it has been scanned for known vulnerabilities.
- [ ] Does this change alter or extend the locked architecture? If so, an ADR was added under `docs/adr/` before implementation.
